# authwise_guard_relay_pool (Resource)

An estate relay pool: a named set of relays shared across networks and tenants. Operators only. `select` orders the pool's relays for a node, `served-order` (priority, then display name; the default) or `nearest` (by the node's `region`). `default` makes it the estate default pool: every tenant may use it, and it is the default of a tenant without its own (`authwise_guard_relay_pool_access.default_pool`). Setting it on one pool clears it on the previous default. A pool in use is not deleted (`RELAY_POOL_IN_USE`): remove it from networks and from tenants' access first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An estate relay pool, the default every tenant may use. Operators only.
resource "authwise_guard_relay_pool" "us_central" {
  slug         = "us-central"
  display_name = "US central"
  region       = "us-central1"
  select       = "nearest" # by each node's region; or "served-order"
  default      = true
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String) `config` as a JSON object.
- `default` (Boolean)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `region` (String)
- `select` (String)
- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `guard_relay_pool_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `relay_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_guard_relay_pool.us_central rp-01
terraform import authwise_guard_relay_pool.us_central relay-pools/rp-01
```
